Germany’s e-invoicing requirements are coming, and many teams are working through formats, processes, system landscapes, and ownership questions at the same time. In this short, interactive clinic, **your real questions come first** : this is not a long presentation. We start with a short framing so everyone has the same baseline, then move straight into a **moderated Q&A** . If you submit your question when you register, we can prioritise and keep the session as practical as possible.


## What you will take away


- Clear answers to your specific questions (live or in the follow-up)
- Practical visibility into risks, dependencies, and common pitfalls
- Concrete next steps and priorities for your roadmap, both business and technical
- Guidance on how to implement the change pragmatically, without operational risk
